description: This file defines a Flutter widget for a lock screen UI, which displays lock reasons and provides an unlock button integrated with an authentication provider.

classes.name: LockScreen
classes.description: A stateful widget representing the lock screen UI.

classes.name: _LockScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the lock screen's UI state, including lock reason display and unlocking logic.

methods.name: _reasonText
methods.description: Converts a LockReason enum value to a user-friendly string message.

methods.name: _unlock
methods.description: Handles the unlock process by invoking the AuthProvider's unlock method and managing UI state.
